quotes.title: HAT-P-5
quotes.card: HAT-P-5 is a 12th magnitude star in the constellation Lyra, approximately 1,000 light years away from Earth.
quotes.introduction: It is a spectral type G star, about 1.16 solar masses and radii greater than the Sun, and only 200 kelvins hotter.
